name: Average adult · isometric knee extension (n=54)
source: Frey-Law et al. (2012), Journal of Applied Biomechanics 28(6):726–737, Table 2 (PMC7050840, noting the manuscript caption swap between Tables 2 and 3). Sample-size-weighted mean unilateral isometric (0°/s) peak knee extension torque across 54 healthy young adults (30 men, 24 women; Biodex System 3).
